title: CI still runs the tests, and ci-ok still needs them
assertion: In .github/workflows/swerepo-ci.yml, a test job, and a test-<project> job for every folder in .swerepo.toml's [projects] listed, each runs `uv run pytest` as a command of its own at the top of its step's script, is not switched off (if: false) and not allowed to fail (continue-on-error: true) at job or step level, and isn't masked (||, ;, a pipe, &, --version, --help, --collect-only, && unless it is the script's last command). ci-ok's needs names each of them, and ci-ok still fails when one fails: it runs if: always(), isn't allowed to fail, and has a step that reads the jobs' results (NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}) into a variable and then runs `if [ -n "$var" ]; then` with a non-zero `exit` before any other. Both steps stop at their first failing command: GitHub's own bash or sh, no set +e, and no exit before them.

origin.text: SWERepo's hygiene rule pack (spec §6.8, ADR-20261124-cd64): seamspec/hygiene-ci-tests@1.
